page: Microsoft Azure NC288ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a high-capacity virtual machine instance built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 288 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel processor. The instance is equipped with 1032.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 3.58 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes bundled local storage consisting of 15841 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, and it is premium storage capable. Acceleration is supported by a single GPU. The massive local storage capacity and dedicated CPU allocation make it suitable for data-intensive operations, while the GPU provides hardware acceleration for parallel computing tasks.

Given the high density of dedicated vCPUs, substantial NVMe SSD storage, and integrated GPU, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile designed for resource-intensive deployments. It is suited for workloads such as large-scale database hosting, data science jobs, machine learning workloads, and complex simulations requiring both high compute density and fast local storage.
